name: Aoki Tasuku
source:
Hobby: Cooking
Likes: Reading
Dislikes: Conflict

When his childhood friend Toru decided to fight, he wanted to somehow return him to a normal life.
He joins Gai-Zard to protect Toru. He is a healer. He always has a troubled smile on his face.

He is in charge of gathering information within the organization.

Shuffle ~Bokura wa Omoi o Tokihanatsu~ Proflie

A healer who always has a troubled smile on his face. He acts with rational judgment.
He joined Gaither to protect his childhood friend Toru.
Since the destruction of Ganglion, he has often been in a dark and somber mood.
